_comment: Recurring seasonal fishing-ban patterns for the Indian coastal states covered
by the coastal reference table.
READ THIS BEFORE TRUSTING A DATE IN HERE.
Every state issues its closed season each year by gazette notification, and
the dates are not always the same as the previous year. This file records the
recurring pattern that has been observed, NOT the current year's notification.
A date read out of this table is a reason to go and check the gazette, never a
substitute for it. The engine labels every result 'indicative' for that reason.
'confidence' grades how stable each pattern is, and the grade is shown to the
user rather than hidden:
high      - window has held for many consecutive seasons
moderate  - window has moved between seasons
low       - rule is set close to the season and cannot be predicted from the
previous year at all
'low' and 'moderate' entries exist so that a state we know less about is
visibly less certain, instead of reading with the same authority as a state
whose pattern is genuinely stable. Do not raise a grade without a reason in
the basis field.
Dates are MM-DD and both ends are inclusive. A window may wrap the year end.
02-29 is not representable and is rejected at parse time.
Verification for any specific year: the gazette notification issued by the
state's own fisheries department, named in 'authority' on each row, is the
only authority. The Department of Fisheries, Government of India (dof.gov.in)
publishes the national framework that the state notifications sit under.
_source: Department of Fisheries, Government of India (https://www.dof.gov.in/) for the national framework; each row names the state department that issues the binding notification.
_provenance_limitation: These windows were compiled from recurring statutory practice, NOT read out of any individual year's gazette notification, and no row has been checked against a current notification. The _verified_against_gazettes flag is false for that reason and a test enforces that it stays false: a table that started claiming gazette verification would need the actual notifications behind it, which are not in this repository.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Kerala
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern; window has been substantially stable across recent seasons
windows.caveat: Confirm the exact dates in this year's Kerala fisheries notification before relying on them.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Karnataka
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern; window has been substantially stable across recent seasons
windows.caveat: Confirm the exact dates in this year's Karnataka fisheries notification before relying on them.

windows.authority: Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Goa
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern; window has been substantially stable across recent seasons
windows.caveat: Confirm the exact dates in this year's Goa fisheries notification before relying on them.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Maharashtra
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern; window has been substantially stable across recent seasons
windows.caveat: Confirm the exact dates in this year's Maharashtra fisheries notification before relying on them.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Andhra Pradesh
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern, with additional periodic day bans on top that are not modelled here
windows.caveat: Confirm this year's notification, and note that Andhra Pradesh also announces separate periodic day bans that this calendar does not model.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Tamil Nadu
windows.basis: recurring monsoon-season pattern; the end date has moved between seasons
windows.caveat: Confirm the exact dates in this year's Tamil Nadu fisheries notification before relying on them.

windows.authority: Directorate of Fisheries, Government of Odisha
windows.applies_to: bottom-trawl and other mechanised craft; non-mechanised craft are notified on separate dates
windows.basis: recurring pre-monsoon pattern; substantially stable, but the non-mechanised dates are set separately and are not modelled here
windows.caveat: Confirm this year's notification, and note that Odisha notifies non-mechanised craft on separate dates that this calendar does not model.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of Gujarat
windows.basis: recurring pattern, but Gujarat has announced substantially different windows in some seasons
windows.caveat: Gujarat's window has varied widely between seasons. Confirm this year's notification before relying on it.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of West Bengal
windows.applies_to: all fishing craft operating from the state
windows.basis: pattern recorded for the Sundarbans and the Hooghly estuary; the window is announced close to the season and has varied
windows.caveat: This window is set close to the season and has varied between years. Treat it as a weak indicator and confirm with the state department.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of India (Andaman & Nicobar Administration)
windows.applies_to: all fishing craft operating in the islands
windows.basis: island administration sets a shorter window than the mainland states, announced close to the season
windows.caveat: The island administration sets this close to the season and it has varied. Treat it as a weak indicator and confirm with the administration.

windows.authority: Department of Fisheries, Government of India (Lakshadweep Administration)
windows.applies_to: all fishing craft operating in the islands
windows.basis: island administration sets a shorter window than the mainland states, announced close to the season
windows.caveat: The island administration sets this close to the season and it has varied. Treat it as a weak indicator and confirm with the administration.
